description: This source file provides helper methods for integration testing comments functionality in the application. Specifically, it contains a method to create a new comment associated with an article, including creating a user if none is specified, and retrieving the created comment from the database context.

classes.name: CommentHelpers
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods for creating and managing comments during integration tests.

methods.name: CreateComment
methods.description: Creates a comment for an article based on the provided command, optionally creating a default user if no username is specified. It then retrieves the created comment from the database context and returns it.
